bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to labor and industry; appropriating money for apprenticeship readiness programming.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; BUILDING STRONG COMMUNITIES, INC.

$400,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $400,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of labor and industry for a grant to Building Strong Communities, Inc. for a statewide apprenticeship readiness program that prepares women; individuals who are Black, Indigenous, and People of Color; and veterans to enter the building and construction industries. These appropriations are onetime.
additions: $400,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $400,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of labor and industry for a grant to Building Strong Communities, Inc. for a statewide apprenticeship readiness program that prepares women; individuals who are Black, Indigenous, and People of Color; and veterans to enter the building and construction industries. These appropriations are onetime.
